# DWIND - Tailwind-like CSS for Rust/WebAssembly

DWIND (Dominator Wind) provides Tailwind-like CSS utility classes for DOMINATOR web applications. All styling compiles into your WASM binary with automatic dead code elimination.

## Documentation Index

- [dwind-quickstart.md](./dwind-quickstart.md) - Macro syntax, breakpoints, pseudo-classes, reactive styling
- [dwind-classes.md](./dwind-classes.md) - Complete CSS utility class reference
- [dwui-components.md](./dwui-components.md) - UI component library (buttons, modals, inputs, cards)
- [dwind-glass-components.md](./dwind-glass-components.md) - Glassmorphic design system (dwind-glass)
- [design-system-guide.md](./design-system-guide.md) - Guide to building design systems with the DWIND stack
- [dwind-dock.md](./dwind-dock.md) - Dockable panel system (tabs, splits, floating panels)
- [dwind-tauri.md](./dwind-tauri.md) - Tauri desktop application setup and integration

## Quick Start

```rust
use dominator::{html, Dom};
use dwind::prelude::*;

fn my_component() -> Dom {
    html!("div", {
        // Basic styling
        .dwclass!("flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 bg-gray-900 rounded-lg")

        // Responsive breakpoints
        .dwclass!("@sm:flex-row @md:gap-8")

        // Hover/focus states
        .dwclass!("hover:bg-gray-800 focus:ring-2")

        .child(html!("button", {
            .dwclass!("px-4 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-600")
            .text("Click me")
        }))
    })
}
```

## Key Concepts

1. **dwclass!** - Apply utility classes to DOMINATOR elements
2. **dwclass_signal!** - Apply classes conditionally based on reactive signals
3. **Breakpoints** - `@sm:`, `@md:`, `@lg:`, `@xl:` for responsive design
4. **Pseudo-classes** - `hover:`, `focus:`, `nth-child(n):` etc.
5. **Variants** - `[& > *]:`, `[& selector]:` for child styling

## Crates

| Crate | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `dwind` | Main library - Tailwind-like utilities |
| `dwind-macros` | Procedural macros (dwclass!, dwclass_signal!) |
| `dwind-base` | Runtime utilities, media query helpers |
| `dwui` | Themeable UI component library |
| `dwind-glass` | Glassmorphic design system (frosted glass components) |
| `dwind-dock` | Dockable panel system with drag-and-drop |

## Dependencies

```toml
[dependencies]
dominator = "0.5"
dwind = { git = "https://github.com/user/dominator-css-bindgen" }
dwui = { git = "https://github.com/user/dominator-css-bindgen" }       # optional
dwind-dock = { git = "https://github.com/user/dominator-css-bindgen" } # optional
futures-signals = "0.3"
```
